description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] PHASE 2 (API): Places a temporary hold on a previously returned offer_id. Locks price/inventory for a TTL when the partner supports api_hold. Does not charge the principal. If the partner only supports deep_link, returns a structured fallback to geo360_generate_affiliate_link.

offer_id.description: option_id / offer_id from a prior search response

principal_hints.description: Non-sensitive hints only (no PAN). Optional at hold time.

quantity.description: Units to hold (passengers, days, SIMs, etc.)

session_id.description: Stable multi-tool session id for the trip or procurement thread

name: geo360_hold_offer
